entries.title: Embodied Cognition
takeaways: Embodied Cognition is a wide-ranging research program drawing from and inspiring work in psychology, neuroscience, ethology, philosophy, linguistics, robotics, and artificial intelligence.

entries.title: Delusion
takeaways: The nature of delusions is a matter of controversy, but in most definitions delusions are often characterised as unusual beliefs that appear in the context of mental distress.
Indeed, clinical delusions are considered a symptom of psychiatric disorders such as dementia, schizophrenia, and delusional disorders.
They can be associated with depression and obsessive-compulsive disorder as well.
